# LostStreet

> LostStreet is a free, fun world detective and geography guessing game. Players get dropped onto a random 360-degree street view anywhere in the world and use visual clues to guess where they are.

## Overview
LostStreet turns the whole Earth into a fun detective game. You don't need a passport or plane tickets—just look around, find clues, and make your guess!

- **Website**: https://www.loststreet.online
- **Cost**: 100% Free (No subscription, no paywalls, no login required to play)
- **Coverage**: Over 780,000 hand-picked, high-quality street view locations across 195+ countries
- **Key Experience**: Fun, relaxing, educational, and competitive world exploration

## Game Modes
- **Singleplayer**: Play solo at your own speed across Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert difficulties.
- **1v1 Multiplayer Duels**: Challenge friends or random players in real-time battles. Guess faster and closer to deal damage and win ELO rating points.
- **Flag Guesser**: Test your knowledge of world flags in quick, fast-paced rounds.
- **Party Rooms**: Create a private room code and play together with a group of friends or classmates.
- **Country Chronicles**: A complete world encyclopedia with maps, photos, and fun facts for every country.
- **Daily Rewards & Streaks**: Log in every day to claim 3D Gold Coins, level up your streak, and unlock bonus items.

## How to Play
1. **Look Around**: Move your camera 360 degrees to check the road, buildings, nature, and sky.
2. **Find Clues**: Look for road signs, language on shop signs, driving side (left or right), sun direction, and unique cars.
3. **Make Your Guess**: Click on the world map or pick from multiple-choice options.
4. **Score Points**: The closer your guess is to the real spot, the more points and coins you earn!

## In-Game Power-Ups
- **✂️ 50/50**: Removes 2 wrong answers in Multiple Choice mode (costs 20 Coins).
- **💡 Hint**: Gives you a helpful clue about the local language, continent, or climate (costs 15 Coins).
- **🔍 Circle Search**: Searches a narrowed radius around the target.
